claim.statement: GitLab's current documentation describes distinct Developer Flow invocation paths through a configured mention, assignment to the Duo Developer service account, the Implement work item control and, from GitLab 19.2 behind a feature flag, Agentic Chat.

source.title: Developer Flow
source.locator: Use the flow and Agentic Chat history sections

lifecycle.reason: Current documentation includes a later Agentic Chat path separately marked as introduced in 19.2.

limitations: The four invocation paths have different release and configuration scopes and are not interchangeable.
The Agentic Chat path postdates 18.8 and is not evidence about the exact 18.8.0-ee source release.
unknowns: The enabled trigger events, selected service account and effective feature flags are unknown.
The exact current UI and backend revision for each offering are unknown.
